headline: Liquidity cover is 3.0 months — build it before adding risk
reasoning: Liquid assets cover 3.0 months of the ₹3,70,000 a month going out, against a six-month buffer. Until that gap closes, new money is better parked in cash and deposits than in growth assets.

headline: Trend is constructive — 4 of 4 moving averages reclaimed
reasoning: The Nifty is at 25,155, above 4 of its four reference moving averages, with RSI at 100. That RSI is stretched, so momentum is worth fading rather than chasing.

headline: Volatility contained — India VIX at 13.4
reasoning: India VIX is 13.4 against a long-run mid-teens average. Option markets are calm, which removes the case for defensive positioning on volatility grounds alone.

headline: Nearest goal is 9 years away — duration risk is affordable
reasoning: The binding constraint is the nearest goal, 9 years out, not the longest one. That is long enough to ride out a normal cycle, so fixed income can play a diversifying rather than a protective role.

headline: Gold at 8% — hedge is adequate
reasoning: Gold is 8% of the portfolio against a 5% hedging allocation for current conditions. It is held for its behaviour when equities fall, not for its own return, so the position is sized rather than maximised.

headline: Saving 0% of income — keep the plan simple

headline: Up to ₹45,000 of tax available this year
reasoning: Purchase dates are not in the bank's data, so holding periods and cost basis cannot be computed — the gains work needs a portfolio import first.
